name: JavaScript Endpoint & Secret Miner
description: High-speed client-side JavaScript bundle and source map analyzer. Extracts hidden API endpoints, administrative routes, GraphQL queries, AWS S3/GCP storage buckets, and hardcoded API tokens from compiled single-page applications.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

extract_source_maps.description: Probe for exposed .js.map source map files to recover original pre-compiled TypeScript/React source code

detect_cloud_buckets.description: Extract references to Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, and Azure Blob storage containers

extract_hidden_endpoints.description: Regex mining of internal REST routes (/api/v1/..., /internal/..., /admin/...)
